violation_type.title: Communicable Diseases That Exclude Child from Care (26 TAC §746.3603)
violation_type.short_title: Communicable Diseases That Exclude Child from Care
violation_type.typical_finding: A child who was ill was accepted at the child care center without a a health care professional's statement stating that the child no longer has an excludable disease or condition.    Note: Child was picked up from the center during the inspection.
